scripts.doc-setup: python3 -m venv .venv-doc && ./.venv-doc/bin/python -m pip install pypdf && ./.venv-doc/bin/python -c "import sys, subprocess; subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', 'pyobjc-framework-Vision', 'pyobjc-framework-Quartz']) if sys.platform == 'darwin' else print('Skipping pyobjc (Apple Vision OCR is macOS-only); document extraction still works.')"
